entry.title: rvaMORE, November 5
entry.content:
From rvaMORE



Rock by rock, every stone in the new Texas Beach causeway was portaged and set by hand as our trail crew rebuilt a rotting wooden feature.
As you ride this years TDFL, think about all the projects and workdays you’ve seen, helped with, and how our trail network has grown over the years.
Join us on November 15th by signing up at the link in our bio for one of three mountainbike routes: a 19, 30, or 50-ish mile day await.
Registration fees go back to our trail network, helping provide resources for the trailbuilders and networks you love to ride, run, hike, and explore along.

Hit that link in our bio, and get ready for a fun Tour de Fall Line!

entry.title: rvaMORE, October 30
entry.content:
From rvaMORE









This November, our gratitude for the James River Parks System steps forward. Our ability to find peace, run, hike, swim, paddle, ride, observe nature, and generally adventure in a unique urban greenspace is truly one of the things that makes Richmond so special - and we want to protect that so generations to come can cherish the same experiences.
November is FULL of ways to give back, and we can’t encourage you enough to jump in and show your support, whether you enjoy the park for personal enjoyment or even have a business that sends customers/leads adventures there. This is about ALL of us celebrating our natural resources, however we find most fun.
—-
@jamesriverpark Kicks off the celebration with Rooted and Wild, November 5-6, with a huge list of events taking place in or around @studiotwothree and you really don’t want to miss this one. From yoga to hiking with a renowned local nature photographer, a painting workshop to a massive silent aution - your donations help support our entire park network.
—-
@jroc.rva returns for another great year of the James River Rush on November 8th - whether you sign up to race or come out to cheer folks on as they trail run, mountainbike, or paddle - your donations help support park staff and projects within the park during this FUN adventure race.
—-
@rvamore will host its TENTH annual TdFL on Nov. 15th - a mountain bike trail tour of the James River Basin with three course lengths ranging from 19-52 miles. Rides finish with a big family style meal, and proceeds help support trail projects in the Richmond region.
—-
@_tim_barry_ throws an incredible weekend long festival called Novemberfest from the 20th to 22nd, with a great setlist of musicians and park-facing projects that help sustain the places we love.

Click any of the tagged partners to go to their profile page and sign up/help out.

We hope to see you out there!

entry.title: rvaMORE, October 11
entry.content:
From rvaMORE



The best kept secret this side of the Piedmont.

Friends, riders, and everyone that loves to support the trails:
The annual TDFL returns for its TENTH iteration on Sunday, November 15th and we hope you can join us.
Registration is quietly live, so jump in today and beat the price bump on October 26th!

We hear a lot of folks ask “why pay to ride trails I can ride free every day?” Well, because your registration fees go back to our trails for this event! You get to have a huge, fun ride and big meal, and we pass the proceeds of your registration fees back to our trail teams.

The whole mission of rvaMORE revolves around supporting our trail network, and our all-volunteer board works to make sure that our trailbuilders have the tools they need when their municipal budgets run dry, that big projects get handled with help needed through organized volunteer workdays, and that we work with our regional government partners to advocate for our trail networks. Its that simple.

Jump in early to secure the lowest cost registration, but don’t worry. If youre worried about the weather, there will be walk up registration available.
